title: Serum sodium–albumin interaction in cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: An albumin-by-serum-sodium product did not meet the registered incremental prediction criterion for concurrent log-hsCRP: source whole-PSU CV MSE gain -0.000549; frozen-source NHANES2017–2018 gain -0.000208 squared log units (500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.007210,0.002080]). Retrospective cross-cycle testing,not untouched or non-NHANES validation. Source n=4225,target n=3955;target baseline/augmented weighted MSE 0.716735/0.716943. No causal hydration mechanism or clinical utility is established. AI-authored public-data computation.
